title: The Jury's Out
summary: Brand and website, with an AI programme companion, for an online programme by two London psychotherapists.
intro: The Jury's Out is a self-paced online programme for people stuck in relationship deadlock: unsure whether to stay, leave or give it more time. It was created by Lisa and Lori Jury, two London psychotherapists with nearly fifty years of clinical practice between them. It's my first commissioned project.

facts.Scope: Brand, website and AI programme companion
facts.Status: Brand directions in development, full site to follow
